test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 8 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: The ‘Stree Manoraksha’ project aimed at extending mental health training to 6000 OSC (One Stop Centre) functionaries across India was launched by ________ in March 2022.
solution:
The correct answer is **'__Smriti Zubin Irani__'.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

 
• The **Ministry of Women and Child Development is celebrating International Women’s Day week from 1st to 8th March 2022** as a part of nationwide celebrations of ‘**Azadi Ka Amrit Mahotsav’**.
 
• In **collaboration with NIMHANS,** the **“Stree Manoraksha project” was launched **by the Union Minister for Women and Child Development,** Smriti Zubin Irani.**
 
• The project is **aimed at extending mental health training to 6000 OSC f**unctionaries across India.
 
• Later in the day,** a consultative conclave on capacity building of OSCs was organised** in collaboration with NALSA.
 
• The event was attended by Government officials, representatives of NIMHANS, NALSA and the representatives of OSCs from across the country
